title: machine learning powered financial credit scoring: a systematic literature review
core_idea: Provide a systematic literature review of machine-learning-based financial credit scoring methods published between 2018 and 2024 to identify major ML techniques, assess their strengths and limitations, highlight trends and advancements, and discuss critical challenges in adopting ML models for credit scoring.
tldr: A systematic review of ML approaches to financial credit scoring (2018–2024) that maps prevailing methods, evaluates their strengths and limitations, highlights trends and adoption challenges, and points to promising directions for future research.
